messages:
Maya: Heads-up: we're locking down the public announce for 'Optimize v0.9' on Wed 09:00 PT. Marketing needs the final changelog URL, the docs landing, and a short benchmark blurb (one p95 stat + cost delta) by EOD Tue so we can finish the blog and social assets. Can eng/docs confirm publish windows?
Sanjay: Changelog is merged to main; I can generate the permalink now but won't point the announce until docs are live. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/changelog/pull/412 (will update with final URL once published).
Liam: Docs will publish the Optimize guide today. ETA Tue 14:00 PT for the canonical URL. We'll add the requested utm_campaign param when handing over the link.
Olivia: Rollout plan from infra: canary at 09:00 PT in us-west, 30m observation, gradual ramp to 100% at ~09:30 PT. If marketing needs GA content visible at 09:00 for press, we can make the canary endpoint publicly reachable but note capacity will be limited.
Maya: Okay, please confirm whether the canary will return the same demo experience (no feature flags) so the blog screenshots match live behavior. Also need p95 and token-cost-delta numbers for the blog.
Samir: Canary will run the Optimize code path identical to GA. I'll grab p95 snapshots and export a 7-day baseline vs v0.9 run CSV right after canary goes live and post both here.
Priya: Webinar check: Thu 10:00 PT session is set. Landing page exists but lacks the product blurb and final CTA. We want people routed to the SDR queue named 'inbound-launch-optimize' using a tracking param. Can eng ensure docs links include ?utm_campaign=optimize_v0.9 and that the form/webhook payload adds a tag so we can route?
Sanjay: We'll append the utm param to the docs link. Also adding "tag": "optimize-launch" in the webhook payload is fine.
Priya: SDR expects a JSON payload like below; can eng confirm the webhook will include campaign and tag fields?
```
{
  "source": "web-forms",
  "campaign": "optimize_v0.9",
  "tag": "optimize-launch",
  "route_to": "sdr-inbound/optimize"
}
```
We need the tag value exact so the routing rule matches.
Sanjay: Confirmed 10 we'll include campaign and tag fields exactly as above. I'll coordinate with release-bot to ensure the event schema change is bundled with the deploy.
release-bot: Deploy scheduled: service/optimize v0.9 -> canary us-west @ 2025-11-12T09:00:00-08:00; full rollout @ 2025-11-12T09:30:00-08:00. CI checks: green.
Maya: Great. Marketing deliverables: blog (short narrative, p95 number, cost delta, one chart), 4 social visuals, one short tweet + CTA. Can design get the p95 screenshot + CSV by Tue 15:00 for chart mockups?
Samir: I'll post a p95 dashboard screenshot and attach the CSV by Tue 15:00.
Liam: Docs URL will be live by Tue 14:00: https://docs.redwood.ai/optimize/v0.9 ; we'll hand over the link with ?utm_campaign=optimize_v0.9 appended.
Maya: Once links are up, drop them here with the exact copy (two-sentence max) for the tweet. We'll schedule the announce at Wed 09:05 PT to align with canary start.
Olivia: No blocking issues from eng. We'll monitor canary metrics and have a rollback plan ready if latency/regressions spike.
Priya: SDR playbook: tag inbound leads as "optimize-launch" and set priority P2. I'll confirm routing after the first webhook arrives.
Maya: Final checklist: 1) changelog URL, 2) docs URL with utm, 3) one-line summary for social, 4) p95 screenshot & CSV. Post all here when ready. :thumbsup: 
Sanjay: Expecting to post final changelog + docs link + two-sentence summary Tue 14:10 PT in this thread.
